_about.career.on: 1: the ranks of service beyond the seven stages (Instructor, Guardian, Emissary), teaching, the Table, guard duty and the arts. 0: none of it. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.teach.on: 1: an Instructor may take a student. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.teach.lessonsPerCourse: Lessons in one course (pace, stillness, blows - in that order). (default 3, 1 to 3)
_about.teach.dayCap: Lessons per path day (clock.dayMinutes of play, config/dmzultra/paths.json) that pay the teacher; more are still taught. (default 6, 1 to 24)
_about.teach.pairRestMinutes: Minutes before the same student may pay the same teacher again. (default 60, 0 to 1440)
_about.teach.tpPercent: Percent of a foe's worth of TP (progression/TpScale's base) a paid lesson gives the teacher. (default 50, 0 to 300)
_about.teach.guidancePercent: How much a lesson lifts the student's power, in percent. (default 8, 1 to 25)
_about.teach.guidanceMinutes: How long the lift lasts, in minutes. (default 20, 1 to 120)
_about.teach.guidanceCapPercent: The most any guidance lifts a fighter, in percent (the lifts never add). (default 12, 1 to 25)
_about.teach.offerSeconds: How long an offer of lessons waits for its answer. (default 60, 15 to 600)
_about.teach.reach: How close teacher and student stay, in blocks. (default 12, 4 to 32)
_about.teach.paceBlocks: Lesson of pace: blocks the teacher walks or flies with the student close behind. (default 60, 20 to 400)
_about.teach.stillSeconds: Lesson of stillness: seconds the two stand quiet together. (default 20, 5 to 120)
_about.teach.strikeBlows: Lesson of blows: blows the student lands (on the teacher where blows are allowed, else on foes). (default 8, 2 to 40)
_about.teach.lessonMinutes: A lesson that is not done within this many minutes is let go. (default 6, 1 to 30)
_about.rank.tpFactor: A rank reached pays that many foes' worth of TP per rank number, once. (default 3, 0 to 20)
_about.table.step1: Dishes for the first step of favour. (default 3, 1 to 100)
_about.table.step2: Dishes for the second step of favour. (default 8, 1 to 200)
_about.table.step3: Dishes for the third step of favour. (default 15, 1 to 300)
_about.table.step4: Dishes for the fourth step of favour. (default 25, 1 to 500)
_about.table.discountPerStep: Percent off Whis's prices for each step of favour. (default 5, 0 to 20)
_about.table.feastMinutes: Three new dishes within this many minutes make a feast, which is worth two more. (default 10, 1 to 60)
_about.guard.on: 1: a Guardian may take a post on a sanctuary and file reports. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.guard.askSeconds: How long a request to a visitor (leave, welcome) waits for an answer. (default 60, 15 to 600)
_about.guard.noticeRestMinutes: Minutes before the same visitor is told of to the same Guardian again. (default 10, 0 to 240)
_about.guard.reportDays: Path days between reports to the Grand Priest (a path day is clock.dayMinutes of play, config/dmzultra/paths.json). (default 7, 1 to 60)
_about.guard.reportTpFactor: A report pays that many foes' worth of TP. (default 2, 0 to 20)
_about.guard.reportStarmarks: Former Starmarks a report gives, paid as TP (each worth the base TP once). (default 2, 0 to 20)
_about.guard.pilgrims: 1: a Guardian who keeps their post alone (nobody else on that sanctuary) is visited by NPC pilgrims - the visits the last rank asks for can be answered in singleplayer too. 0: only players visit. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.guard.pilgrimMinutes: Minutes a Guardian stands alone on their post before a pilgrim comes (and between two pilgrims). (default 8, 1 to 120)
_about.path.rescueHelpers: 1: the Envoy stage's rescue abroad also counts for a player who helped in the rescue (not only its leader). 0: only the mission's leader. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.mending.pvpPartyOnly: 1: on a server where players may fight each other, the Angel Staff's Mending reaches only the bearer's party. 0: every player nearby who is not in a match. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.arts.on: 1: the Angel's arts (Step, Reading, Glance, Stopped Moment, Weight). (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.step.costPct: Ki Angel Step takes, in percent of the maximum. (default 6, 0 to 100)
_about.step.wait: Seconds before Angel Step again. (default 8, 0 to 600)
_about.reading.radius: Blocks Ki Reading looks out to. (default 64, 8 to 160)
_about.reading.costPct: Ki Ki Reading takes, in percent of the maximum. (default 5, 0 to 100)
_about.reading.wait: Seconds before Ki Reading again. (default 45, 0 to 600)
_about.glance.seconds: Seconds Glance waits for a blow. (default 8, 2 to 60)
_about.glance.costPct: Ki Glance takes, in percent of the maximum. (default 12, 0 to 100)
_about.glance.softenPercent: How much of the blow Glance turns aside, in percent. (default 70, 10 to 95)
_about.moment.radius: Blocks across the moment reaches. (default 7, 2 to 24)
_about.moment.costPct: Ki Stopped Moment takes, in percent of the maximum. (default 20, 0 to 100)
_about.moment.wait: Seconds before Stopped Moment again. (default 90, 0 to 1800)
_about.weight.radius: Blocks Weight reaches round the Angel. (default 9, 2 to 24)
_about.weight.seconds: Seconds the weight lies on a foe. (default 5, 1 to 30)
_about.weight.costPct: Ki Weight takes, in percent of the maximum. (default 15, 0 to 100)
_about.staff.restoreStars: 1: the Angel Staff's Restoration also brings back destroyed stars and gas giants, not only worlds and moons (wave A2). 0: worlds and moons only, as before. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.staff.partyAlong: 1: the Angel Staff's Passage takes the bearer's party along, as Kai Kai does (each member's own "comes along" switch and carry setting still count; wave A2). 0: the bearer goes alone. (default 1, 0 to 1)
